99665529.role: AWS Cloud Data Developer with Node.js
99665529.job_description:
Job Summary:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced **AWS Cloud Data Developer** with strong expertise in **Node.js**, **.NET Core Web API**, and **AWS services** to design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines for cloud-based applications. The ideal candidate will have solid experience building backend APIs, working with serverless architectures (AWS Lambda), NoSQL databases (DynamoDB), and DevOps practices in AWS.

 

**Key Responsibilities** 

- Design, develop, and maintain efficient data pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and processing. 

- Develop robust Node.js / Express.js backend APIs with comprehensive unit testing (Jest/Mocha). 

- Build and manage serverless functions using **AWS Lambda** for event-driven tasks. 

- Implement and optimize NoSQL databases including **DynamoDB**, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch. 

- (Optional) Design and deploy containerized applications using **AWS EKS**. 

- (Optional) Provision and manage additional AWS services: EC2, S3, API Gateway, SQS, SES, and Pinpoint. 

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (DevOps, Data Science, etc.) to understand data requirements and deliver effective solutions. 

- Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools. 

- Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines to ensure data quality, performance, and system health. 

- Stay current with latest trends in cloud technologies and data engineering best practices.

 

**Mandatory Skills** 

- Strong experience with **.NET Core Web API** (using MVC Core). 

- Hands-on expertise in **AWS DevOps Services**, **AWS Lambda**, and **DynamoDB**. 

- Proficiency in **Node.js** for backend development. 

 

**Good to Have Skills** 

- AWS AI Services, AWS API Gateway, Java, PostgreSQL. 

- Experience with container orchestration (AWS EKS). 

- Familiarity with additional AWS services (EC2, S3, SQS, SES, Pinpoint).

 

**Qualifications** 

- 4 to 7 years of experience as a Cloud Data Engineer or in a related role. 

- Strong understanding of data engineering principles and methodologies. 

- Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. 

- Ability to work independently as well as part of a cross-functional team.

99559.job_description: We are seeking a Senior SQL Developer with over 5 years of experience to lead the design, optimization, and scaling of our enterprise database systems. In this role, you will own the database architecture, mentor junior developers, and solve complex performance bottlenecks to support our high-traffic applications. Key Responsibilities Architecture Design: Architect scalable, highly available database structures and complex data models. Performance Tuning: Analyze execution plans, optimize indexes, and rewrite slow-running queries to minimize latency. Pipeline Development: Design robust, automated ETL/ELT pipelines to integrate disparate data streams. Database Governance: Define enterprise standards for code reviews, deployment scripts, and database documentation. Security & Compliance: Implement advanced data masking, encryption, and role-based access controls. Technical Leadership: Mentor junior engineers and collaborate with software architects on infrastructure decisions. Required Skills & Qualifications Proven Experience: Minimum 5–7 years of professional experience as a dedicated SQL Developer or Database Engineer. Engine Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of enterprise engines like Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL.Advanced Code: Mastery of T-SQL or PL/SQL, including complex dynamic SQL, window functions, and error handling. Infrastructure: Deep understanding of database replication, clustering, partitioning, and disaster recovery strategies. Cloud Platforms: Experience deploying and managing databases in cloud environments like AWS (RDS) or Azure SQL. DevOps Integration: Familiarity with database version control (e.g., Flyway, Liquibase) and CI/CD deployment pipelines.

663525.job_description: Job Title: Senior Full Stack Developer / AI Quantitative Engineer Location: New York, NY (Hybrid)Job Type: Full-Time About the Role We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Full Stack Developer and AI Systems Consultant to join our technology team. In this role, you will partner directly with portfolio managers, trading desks, and quantitative researchers to design, build, and scale mission-critical trading and investment platforms. You will bridge the gap between complex quantitative analytics and enterprise architecture, with a heavy emphasis on integrating LLM-driven automation into our trading lifecycle. Key Responsibilities AI/LLM Integration: Spearhead AI automation initiatives using Azure Semantic Kernel SDK (chat completions, vector search, REST integrations) to automate financial workflows and processes. Trading & Risk Systems: Architect and develop high-performance systems for trade, position, risk, P&L, hedging, and sizing, exposed via robust web API layers. Platform Development: Contribute to the architecture of systematic portfolio engines, integrating quantitative signals, portfolio construction algorithms, and strategy evaluation frameworks. Front-to-Back Engineering: Build scalable, end-to-end technology platforms that translate complex investment ideas into seamless, user-friendly production tools for investment teams. Consultative Collaboration: Partner with PMs, traders, and quant teams to solve complex problems in signal research infrastructure, investment analytics, and trading workflows. Qualifications & Requirements Experience: 15+ years of software engineering experience delivering high-performance financial/trading systems. Technical Stack: Expert-level full-stack development experience (backend APIs, frontend web layers).Strong background in Cloud-hosted LLMs and AI automation; hands-on experience with the Azure Semantic Kernel SDK. Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of capital markets, including portfolio construction, signal research, risk management, and P&L. Quantitative Acumen: Proven track record of building systematic portfolio engines and partnering with quantitative analysts. Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills with a history of translating abstract investment ideas into scalable technical platforms.

PYD-001.job_description:
Senior Python Developer - Market Risk & Data Engineering Platform

We are seeking a Senior Python Developer (10+ years) to join our Market Risk and Data Engineering platform team. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise building production Python systems for financial risk platforms, event-driven data pipelines, and cloud-native microservices.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and develop scalable Python microservices and RESTful APIs using FastAPI, Flask or Django for risk analytics and data platform consumers
- Build and maintain risk aggregation pipelines (VaR, stress testing, scenario management) processing positions, market data and trade exposures
- Develop event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis, Azure Event Hubs or Google Pub/Sub for real-time market data ingestion and risk event processing
- Architect cloud-native data services on AWS, Azure or GCP integrating PostgreSQL, Snowflake or BigQuery using SQLAlchemy ORM
- Implement containerized microservices using Docker and Kubernetes (EKS / AKS / GKE)
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or GitLab CI/CD
- Develop ML/AI pipeline integrations using scikit-learn, LangChain, Vertex AI or Azure OpenAI for risk analytics workflows
- Enforce data quality, testing and observability using PyTest, Great Expectations, Datadog and Prometheus

Required Skills:
- 8+ years of Python development (OOP, decorators, asyncio, context managers, custom exceptions)
- FastAPI / Flask / Django - production RESTful and async API development
- Pandas, NumPy, SQLAlchemy - data processing and ORM
- Apache Kafka / AWS Kinesis / Azure Event Hubs - event-driven streaming
- PostgreSQL / Oracle / MongoDB - relational and NoSQL data architecture
- Docker, Kubernetes - containerization and orchestration
- AWS / Azure / GCP - cloud platform proficiency
- CI/CD - GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD
- PyTest, unittest - automated testing and quality assurance

Nice to Have:
- Experience with Quartz (Citi), Athena (JPMC) or SecDB (Goldman) risk platforms
- VaR engines, stress testing frameworks, scenario management
- LangChain, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI - Generative AI and RAG pipelines
- Snowflake, Databricks, Amazon Redshift - enterprise data warehousing
- Terraform, Pulumi - Infrastructure as Code

Education: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field
